statement: Everything below was fixed on the development fold (train drug groups only) before any prediction for the 70 held-out test drug groups. A change after this commit is a new version with a new tag; nothing here is overwritten.
exposure: pre-specified follow-up on a public benchmark this project has already analysed; not a blind test

model_config.note: revision 1 head (additive, drug-specific shrinkage 10) for every arm; encoder d=128, 2 blocks, 256 tokens

ridge.note: penalties from Z0_dev_v2; drug penalty at the grid edge after the one allowed extension

public_reference.model: chemCPA 43e830eb, earlier study's frozen P0_lr0.3 seeds 42/43/44, not retrained, no thinning augmentation
public_reference.counts_as_beaten_only_if: reported with the caveat that it is not a same-training-condition comparison

evaluation.primary: p=0.25, N=64: per-condition delta RMSE over 2,000 genes -> mean within drug group -> unweighted mean over drug groups; averaged over 3 training seeds and 3 thinning seeds per condition
evaluation.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over drug groups (5,000 resamples, seed 0), 95% interval
evaluation.guard: p=1.0: an arm whose error is more than 1% above B00's is reported as not adopted
evaluation.hcc: SNU-423 (CVCL_0366) sub-table, pre-specified; one cell line, no patient-HCC claim
evaluation.views: p=1.0 (identity), p=0.5 and p=0.25 with thinning seeds 0,1,2 stored in the contract cache

decision_rules: B11 better than B00 and Z0 by the rule, and not worse than DEN: claim added value of response-preserving training
only B10 better than B00: conclude an observation-feature gain and drop the teacher
B01 ~ B11 (difference not meeting the rule): do not claim the input change is necessary
no arm of the 2x2 differs from B00 by the rule: limited conclusion that the more complex state encoder/training is not needed for this depth / mean-response task
reconstruction better but delta worse: do not adopt

attribution.rule: only for a module that is better than B00 by the rule in the final table
attribution.if_teacher_helps: rerun B01 or B11 (the better one) with response-only and latent-only auxiliary weights, 3 seeds, same settings
attribution.if_obs_input_helps: none beyond B10 vs B00 (the input is a single switch)
